summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle on install
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, unzips it, `chmod 755`s the binary, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line `@bun-cjs` compiled bundle with shuffled string-array obfuscation (`_0x...` identifiers, rotating string array `WV8StW`); its filename is unrelated to the package's declared SDK purpose and it is not required by `dist/cjs/index.js`. `setup.mjs` is itself variable-name-obfuscated. No hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded runtime or on the executed payload. The alternate-runtime path routes execution around Node-level static analysis: the code that actually runs on `npm install` is opaque Bun bytecode with `with` statements that resists standard JavaScript deobfuscation. Installing the package causes this bundle to execute automatically, granting arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine with the identity of the installing user.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
